annotations.text:
The sheet is the product (docs/interface.md). Content is real: FD 36873's August 2026 record from the store. Decisions are tinted rows with the Board's own summary, sentence-cased; filings show type and the 'filed for' cell as printed. Dates quoted, never computed.

Display preferences (the tweak chips above the desktop board): density comfortable/compact, record IDs on/off, light/dark. In the product these are per-viewer, browser-stored — never an account or a paper trail.

Retired 2026-08-25 after the direction was chosen. Harvested into the main sheet: Ledger's density and record-ID column became display preferences; Broadsheet's sentence-style record summary moved into the caption.
